# core/ed25519.bastio

<!-- Generated by tests/libref.py from core/ed25519.bastio: edit the source, then run tests/libref.py --write. -->

Ed25519 signature verification (RFC 8032 section
5.1.7), on the field arithmetic of core/x25519.bastio and the hash of
core/sha512.bastio.

What is proved: every access is in bounds, nothing leaks, and the
functions return what their types say. Not proved: that `ed25519_verify`
accepts exactly the signatures RFC 8032 accepts (the tests check the
RFC's vectors, signatures made by another implementation, and every
single-bit change of a signature, a message and a key being refused).
Verification works on public data only, so nothing here is constant time.

A point is a `Vec[u64]` of 64 limbs: the extended coordinates X, Y, Z and
T, 16 limbs each, with x = X/Z, y = Y/Z and x * y = T/Z.

`import "core/ed25519.bastio";` also loads [core/option.bastio](core-option.md), [core/bytes.bastio](core-bytes.md), [core/x25519.bastio](core-x25519.md), [core/endian.bastio](core-endian.md), [core/text.bastio](core-text.md), [core/sha512.bastio](core-sha512.md).

| Function | |
| --- | --- |
| [`ed25519_verify`](#ed25519_verify) | Whether `sig` (64 bytes. |

Every example below is built, verified and run by `tests/run.sh`. An `assert` in one is proved at compile time from the contracts above it.

## Functions

### `ed25519_verify`

```bastio
fn ed25519_verify(pubkey: &Bytes, msg: &Bytes, sig: &Bytes) -> bool
  requires blen(pubkey) == 32 && blen(sig) == 64 && blen(msg) < 1000000000
```

Whether `sig` (64 bytes: R, then S) is a valid Ed25519 signature of `msg`
under the public key `pubkey` (32 bytes). The signature is refused if S is
not below the group order or the key is not a point.

Example:

```bastio
let pubkey = balloc(32);
let sig = balloc(64);
let msg = bfrom("hello");
// All zeros is not a signature of anything.
let ok = ed25519_verify(pubkey, msg, sig);
bfree(msg);
bfree(sig);
bfree(pubkey);
if ok { return 1; }
```

## Internals

### `ed_nib`

```bastio
fn ed_nib(c: u8) -> u8
  ensures result < 16
```

Internal: the nibble of the hex digit `c`.

### `ed_const`

```bastio
fn ed_const(s: Str) -> Vec[u64]
  requires slen(s) == 64
  ensures vlen(result) == 16
```

Internal: the field element whose 32 little-endian bytes are the 64 hex
digits of `s`.

### `ed_get`

```bastio
fn ed_get(p: &Vec[u64], k: u64) -> Vec[u64]
  requires vlen(p) == 64 && k < 4
  ensures vlen(result) == 16
```

Internal: limbs `16 * k..16 * k + 16` of `p` (a coordinate), copied.

### `ed_make`

```bastio
fn ed_make(x: &Vec[u64], y: &Vec[u64], z: &Vec[u64], t: &Vec[u64]) -> Vec[u64]
  requires vlen(x) == 16 && vlen(y) == 16 && vlen(z) == 16 && vlen(t) == 16
  ensures vlen(result) == 64
```

Internal: the point with the coordinates `x`, `y`, `z` and `t`.

### `ed_identity`

```bastio
fn ed_identity() -> Vec[u64]
  ensures vlen(result) == 64
```

Internal: the neutral point (0, 1).

### `ed_add`

```bastio
fn ed_add(p: &Vec[u64], q: &Vec[u64]) -> Vec[u64]
  requires vlen(p) == 64 && vlen(q) == 64
  ensures vlen(result) == 64
```

Internal: the sum of the points `p` and `q` (the complete addition law of
the twisted Edwards curve, which also doubles).

### `ed_mul`

```bastio
fn ed_mul(p: &Vec[u64], k: &Bytes) -> Vec[u64]
  requires vlen(p) == 64 && blen(k) < 1000
  ensures vlen(result) == 64
```

Internal: the scalar `k` (little-endian bytes) times the point `p`, by
doubling and adding from the top bit down.

### `ed_base`

```bastio
fn ed_base() -> Vec[u64]
  ensures vlen(result) == 64
```

Internal: the base point.

### `fe_pow2523`

```bastio
fn fe_pow2523(a: &Vec[u64]) -> Vec[u64]
  requires vlen(a) == 16
  ensures vlen(result) == 16
```

Internal: `a` to the power (p - 5) / 8 = 2^252 - 3.

### `ed_bytes`

```bastio
fn ed_bytes(a: &Vec[u64]) -> Bytes
  requires vlen(a) == 16
  ensures blen(result) == 32
```

Internal: the bytes of the field element `a`, reduced.

### `ed_decompress`

```bastio
fn ed_decompress(b: &Bytes) -> Option[Vec[u64]]
  requires blen(b) == 32
  ensures result is Option::Some ==> vlen(result.Some) == 64
```

Internal: the point whose compressed form is the 32 bytes `b` (y, then the
parity of x in the top bit), or nothing if there is no such point.

### `ed_compress`

```bastio
fn ed_compress(p: &Vec[u64]) -> Bytes
  requires vlen(p) == 64
  ensures blen(result) == 32
```

Internal: the compressed form of the point `p`: 32 bytes.

### `ed_below_l`

```bastio
fn ed_below_l(s: &Bytes, off: u64) -> bool
  requires blen(s) >= 32 && off <= blen(s) - 32
```

Internal: the scalar `s` (32 little-endian bytes) is below the group order
L = 2^252 + 27742317777372353535851937790883648493.
